name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome and low-vision displays, meeting WCAG AAA. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets, but EXCAVA’s buttons are already oversized for mobile, so it’s negligible.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px. A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast still fails users who need 6:1 for low vision. The real risk is excluding users on high-DPI devices. Settle it by testing both rings on a 4K mobile screen under 150% zoom.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AA for low vision and avoids collapsing on high-DPI screens where 4px shrinks to 2px. The trade-off is slightly lower visibility for users who need AAA, but EXCAVA’s oversized buttons and high-contrast palette already compensate. Test it on a 4K mobile screen under 150% zoom to confirm it doesn’t disappear.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-6625, worker-5396 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 6:1 still cuts out users who need AAA for low vision. Test a 5px ring at 7:1 instead—it avoids collapse on high-DPI screens and meets AAA, balancing visibility and mobile safety. Settle it by measuring ring clarity on a 4K mobile screen at 150% zoom and 200% text size.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 1px outer glow (white) — result: ring visible on high-DPI/monochrome, meets WCAG AAA; owner: Ramp.
